    About me

    I am a senior researcher in Alibaba Group as Top Talent T-star. Before joining Alibaba Group, I obtained my Ph.D. degree at CSE, CUHK, supervised by Prof. Qi Dou, and B.Eng. degree at ISEE, ZJU in 2021, supervised by Prof. Honggang Zhang. In the past, I was very lucky to work at Shanghai AI Lab, Huawei Noah Ark’s Lab, and Sensetime. My research fmainly lie in generative AI and computer vision. Recently, I am working on large-scale video generation and post training.

    Our team is hiring full-time researchers and interns to work on AIGC-related topics, including but not limited to video/image generation and editing. Feel free to contact me via email if you are passionate about the above areas! Any form of project collaboration is also welcome!
